svg.aria-label: Shared L2, textbook form: 12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines in two halves, physically indexed and hashed
svg.text: Shared L2, textbook form: 12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines in two halves, physically indexed and hashed
Four cores share it. The index is physical and partly hashed, each line is two independent 64 B halves, and the replacement spares lines an L1 still holds.
the index needs bits above the 16 KiB page, so this lookup waits for translation
One set: 12 ways, each a 128 B line as two 64 B halves
way 4 half 0 is the line being read
Hit latency, 17 cycles from the core
single source; 15 and 18 also quoted; the split is mine
the lookup order is a patent reading
Design issues, in the textbook order
two index bits are an XOR of higher page number bits; which two is not
8192 sets × 12 ways × 128 B = 12 MiB ● · 11 index bits direct, 2 hashed ○ (S2C)
per core stacks, round robin victim
spares lines an L1D still holds
L1 copy bits from duplicate L1 tags
sense amps of those ways only
all zero line kept as a tag bit
untouched half stays in the L2 until
used, or both halves fill the L1
half own core, half spare for others
half own core, half spare for others
half own core, half spare for others
half own core, half spare for others
spare halves of the other three: 4.5 MiB ○
about 7.5 MiB in all; whether the cachelets are physical slices or a policy is open
Proposed: the two hashed bits pick the slice, a remote slice costs a fabric hop
test: pin a core, pick addresses per slice, look for a 4 way latency split instead of one step at 3 MiB
ordering: in order within one 128 B line, may pass across lines ~ · a core's read of half 1 can pass its own write of half 0 ○
request arrives: PA, index 19:9 and the two hashed bits pick the set
partial tag compare on a few bits fires 2 of 12 ways
full 20 b compare on those: way 4 hits, half 0 is valid
half 0 returns to the L1D as two 32 B beats, 17 clk in all
128 B as two 64 B sectors, own v and d
streams and unused prefetches enter low
write back; dirty per half later
inclusive of the L1Ds; victims to the SLC
three way groups that sleep when idle
